name: Gaia Project
variant: base (expansion The Lost Fleet not modelled)

categories.label: Victory points before final scoring
categories.labelVi: Điểm VP trước khi tính điểm cuối
categories.hint: Marker on the VP track (starts at 10) after round 6.

categories.label: Final scoring tile 1
categories.hint: Rank on the tile's track: 1st/2nd/3rd/4th = 18/12/6/0; ties split the VP of the shared ranks evenly. Enter VP gained.

categories.label: Research levels 3, 4, 5
categories.hint: Count each level 3, 4 and 5 reached or passed across all six tracks.

categories.label: Leftover credits, knowledge, ore
categories.hint: 1 VP per 3 resources in any combination.

notes: Game ends after round 6. Final tiles come from: most structures in federations, most structures, most planet types, most Gaia planets, most sectors, most satellites. In 1-2 player games a neutral player's satellites occupy a rank, which can push the human players down a rank. Power/Q.I.C. and other resources do not convert to VP. Rank-based tile awards (with tie splitting) are entered as final VP rather than computed. The rulebook has no extra tiebreaker: tied players share victory. Lost Fleet extras (Lost Planet, Ivits) only affect what counts in final tiles.
